items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: Who was Clem Geddes? He was Undertaker, you know.

ctx.x: Who was Clem Geddes? He was Undertaker, you know. He was Clem Geddes and Morris, you know. Oh, yeah. He was like Geddes and Morris. Yeah. But most of the bands I played with, they didn't go by their names. That's when I didn't know their names or many pieces. They used to sketch the name off of the music, you know, orchestration, you know. And some people used to cut it off in the right numbers. They called by numbers. And these are number three, number 24, like that. We didn't know what we were playing. You see.…

Ask him if he knows. Do you know the words to a number called, Maestres Wagon, Done Been Here and Gone? I didn't think I knew that. That's about the old male, you know. Oh, yeah. And his furniture wagon used to come around and take all the beds back. Oh, yeah. I knew it wasn't.
